commands.command:
set -eu
noexec_test() {
  test_dir=$1
  test_file=$test_dir/.[REDACTED]
  printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'exit 0' > "$test_file"
  chmod 0755 "$test_file"
  if "$test_file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -f "$test_file"
    printf '%s noexec:FAIL\n' "$test_dir"
    return 1
  fi
  rm -f "$test_file"
  printf '%s noexec:PASS\n' "$test_dir"
}
nodev_test() {
  test_dir=$1
  test_file=$test_dir/.antrieb-nodev-test
  rm -f "$test_file"
  mknod "$test_file" c 1 3
  if dd if="$test_file" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f "$test_file"
    printf '%s nodev:FAIL\n' "$test_dir"
    return 1
  fi
  rm -f "$test_file"
  printf '%s nodev:PASS\n' "$test_dir"
}
noexec_test /tmp
noexec_test /dev/shm
nodev_test /tmp
nodev_test /dev/shm
printf 'REQUIRED_FLAGS\n'
for target in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  opts=$(findmnt -no OPTIONS "$target")
  printf '%s %s\n' "$target" "$opts"
  case ",$opts," in *,noexec,*) :;; *) exit 1;; esac
  case ",$opts," in *,nosuid,*) :;; *) exit 1;; esac
  case ",$opts," in *,nodev,*) :;; *) exit 1;; esac
done
printf 'FSTAB_CHECKSUM\n'
sha256sum /etc/fstab
printf 'BOOT_ID\n'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SYSTEM_HEALTH\n'
systemctl is-system-running
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'POST_RESTART_IDENTITY\n'
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'PERSISTENT_CONFIG\n'
awk '$2=="/tmp" || $2=="/dev/shm" {print}' /etc/fstab
printf 'fstab_sha256='; sha256sum /etc/fstab | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'POST_RESTART_MOUNTS\n'
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /tmp
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /dev/shm
stat -c '%n mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /tmp /dev/shm
for target in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  opts=$(findmnt -no OPTIONS "$target")
  case ",$opts," in *,noexec,*) :;; *) printf '%s missing noexec\n' "$target"; exit 1;; esac
  case ",$opts," in *,nosuid,*) :;; *) printf '%s missing nosuid\n' "$target"; exit 1;; esac
  case ",$opts," in *,nodev,*) :;; *) printf '%s missing nodev\n' "$target"; exit 1;; esac
  probe=$target/.[REDACTED]
  printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'exit 0' > "$probe"
  chmod 0755 "$probe"
  if "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -f "$probe"; printf '%s noexec:FAIL\n' "$target"; exit 1; else rm -f "$probe"; printf '%s noexec:PASS\n' "$target"; fi
  probe=$target/.antrieb-nodev-test
  mknod "$probe" c 1 3
  if dd if="$probe" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 2>/dev/null; then rm -f "$probe"; printf '%s nodev:FAIL\n' "$target"; exit 1; else rm -f "$probe"; printf '%s nodev:PASS\n' "$target"; fi
done
printf 'SYSTEM_HEALTH\n'
systemctl is-system-running
if systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | grep .; then exit 1; else printf 'failed_units=0\n'; fi
